ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(CONTAINS($UserRole.DeveloperName, 'Sales_Manager'), CONTAINS($UserRole.DeveloperName, 'Sales_Associate') ) && (TEXT(LeadSource) <> 'Self Generated' && TEXT(LeadSource) <> 'Management Lead') && (ISNEW() || (NOT(ISNEW()) && ISCHANGED(LeadSource))) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, 'Modon - Egypt'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lead Source must be selected as 'Self Generated' or 'Management Lead' for Sales Manager.
